capture.hide_gui_source: the recorder skipped the OVERLAY pass, which is not vanilla hideGUI: this tape's own qrl_launch says hide_gui false with strip.overlays true. All 157 goldens have no hearts, hotbar or crosshair, and they DO draw a first-person viewmodel on nearly every frame - a bare arm on most of them, a held item on a few - so only the overlay was stripped. GuiIngame.renderPortal is drawn inside that pass and is correctly tied to this flag; the hand is not, and hiding it is the workaround described in hand_from_tick_source. Note options.bobView is false here, so the oracle's viewmodel does not bob and sits on identical screen pixels frame to frame
capture.hand_from_tick_source: first golden at which MAGMA's viewmodel is right, not the tick the oracle's hand returns - the oracle draws one throughout and is EMPTY HANDED on most frames, so what it draws is the bare arm (verified by eye at t=0, 900, 1140, 1800, 2400, 2800, 3100). magma has that path and lands it on the right pixels but draws it far too bright: at t=900, a rain-free frame whose terrain and sky agree to 1/255, the arm is golden (139,103,84) against magma (192,173,148), per-channel 0.72/0.60/0.58. Forcing the hand on for the whole tape moves 110 of 157 frames the wrong way on whole mean/ch and only 10 the right way, which is why it is still off. This tick is 2440 because the worldpatch sidecar's two set_inventory rows, t=2274 (item 58) and t=2320 (item 269, slot 6), make 2440 the first golden where a HELD item is also known right. Fix the arm shading and this suppression goes away; see OPEN_DIVERGENCES
